pages.text: Hang a jarred villager on an $(item)Employee Mount$() against a machine. Librarians read DNA better, Clerics steady the Splicer, Fishermen speed the Saline Mixer, Masons spare the blade, smiths stretch your plating, Cartographers widen Relay Masts, Butchers fatten the Leech Jar, Farmers save broth and Fletchers speed turrets.
Staff cost one emerald a day from a chest touching the mount. Unpaid staff work at half the bonus and say so. Nitwits do nothing at all, loudly.
